name: Asterwise API
description:
B2B astrology and divination API.
Vedic (sidereal) and Western (tropical) astrology, numerology, tarot, crystals, dreams, and
horoscopes. Send birth data, get accurate calculations as structured JSON. 117 endpoints,
104 MCP tools, HMAC-signed responses.

**[Get your free API key](https://asterwise.com)** · [Pricing](https://asterwise.com/pages/pricing.html) · [Support](mailto:support@asterwise.com)

---

## Authentication

Add your API key to every request:
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY_HERE
```

Get your key at **asterwise.com** — free, no credit card, instant.

---

## Your first call
```bash
curl https://api.asterwise.com/v1/astro/natal \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Arjun Mehta",
    "date": "1985-11-12",
    "time": "06:45",
    "location": "Mumbai"
  }'
```

---

## Key concepts

**`location`** — Any city name. Resolved automatically.

**`ayanamsa`** — `lahiri` (default) · `raman` · `kp` · `tropical`

---

500 free calls/month
